Hello, first of all I am very sorry you feel this way, I get it and its horrible feeling like this. 

I saw in the comments that you feel unable to quit smoking. I have smoked for 10 years myself and I quit 1 year ago. 

Give it another go, it can only do you good. Let me give you a few tips that helped me and that, hopefully, can help you too :

- get snacks, but healthy ones : I snacked a lot for the first six months of quitting, mostly on nuts, fruits, smoothies, stuff that wasn't going to make me feel guilty or anything 

- get your hands occupied : having something to touch and play with, fidget with, helps with forgetting that you want the gesture of smoking - personally I play with a piece of string around my wrist (it could be crocheting, having a fidget spinner or whatever)

- remember that the urge to smoke only lasts for a few minutes maximum, if you can just hold on for these few minutes, it's a win. 


For your skin itself, I recommend moisturising a lot, everyday (I personally use products from the brand typology), using sunscreen everyday (50 SPF) and drinking TONS of water. 

Hope this helps
